persona.title: Pretend you are…
persona.text: Pretend you are Grace, 20, a Sunday school helper at Mlima Hope Church in Nyeri. Your pastor wants every family to use this app in December, and you will also use it at home with your grandmother, Cucu Wanjiru, and your little brother, Baraka. Today, in October, you are getting everything ready before December comes.

lines: Welcome. This short video explains an app called Advent Together. In about three minutes you will know what it is for and how to use it.
First, one word. Advent means the four weeks before Christmas, when Christians get ready to celebrate the birth of Jesus.
Many families want to pray and read the Bible together during Advent. But life is busy. Nobody remembers today's reading, and the good plan is forgotten after three days.
Advent Together solves that. Every day from the first of December to the twenty fourth, it gives a family one short Bible reading, one prayer, and one small thing to do together.
Who uses it? Parents with children, grandparents with grandchildren, and whole churches, where every family follows the same reading on the same day.
It was made in America, but there is no money in this app. It works the same in Kenya. The Bible verses come from the King James Bible.
Let us walk through the page slowly. Everything is on one long page.
The first time you open it, a welcome card explains the app. Tap Let's begin and the card goes away.

lines.t: At the top is the big card. Before December it counts the days until Advent begins. From December the first, it shows today's reading. Before December you can tap Try the Day 1 sample to see what a day looks like.

Next is the Advent wreath: a ring of green leaves with candles. One more candle is lit each Sunday of Advent: Hope, Peace, Joy and Love. The white candle in the middle is lit on Christmas Eve. The app lights them by itself.
Then come the 24 doors, one for each day of December before Christmas. A door with a lock is not open yet. It opens on its own day. The Today button jumps straight to today's door.

lines: Inside a door you find the Bible verse, a few words to think about, a line for the little ones, a prayer, and one thing to do together.
There is also a Read it aloud button, so the phone reads the whole day to the family, and a Share button.

When your family has done it, you tap We did it. Your family gets a star for that day, and the app counts how many days in a row you have done. Stars only start on the first of December, because each star belongs to its own day.

lines.t: Further down is Our family. Type the names of the people doing Advent with you. Their names then appear on every day's reading. Below the names you see your stars and your days in a row.

Then For churches. Tap Open the church kit. Here a church leader types the church's name. The app makes a one page paper with all 24 readings, ready to print, and a Sunday announcement to copy and read in church.
At the bottom is Settings. Bigger type makes all the words larger. Preview mode is for pastors and teachers: it opens every door now, so you can read ahead. Stars still only come on the real day.

lines: Everything stays on this phone. There is no account.
To start again with nothing in it, empty the family names, empty the church name, and turn off the switches in Settings. The test tells you exactly how.
In the test, you will be Grace, a Sunday school helper in Nyeri, getting ready for December. Take your time, and if something is confusing, say so. Confusing parts are exactly what we want to find.

challenge.intro: Now you are Grace from Mlima Hope Church in Nyeri. It is October, so the doors are still locked and stars cannot be earned yet. Your job is to get the app ready for December. Nobody will tell you which button to press: use what you learned. When you finish, tap Check my work.
challenge.start: Use the NORMAL app link (not the 🧪 test copy). Open Advent Together. If the welcome tour shows, tap 'skip the tour' → '✨ Start fresh with my own' → OK. (This app is not in the house erase list, so there is no 🧹 Start fresh link at the bottom. Empty it by hand instead.) Then: 1) scroll to 'Our family' and delete everything in the box 'Who’s doing Advent together?'; 2) tap '⛪ Open the church kit', delete anything in 'Your church’s name', and close it with ✕; 3) open '⚙️ Settings' at the bottom and make sure 'Bigger type' and 'Preview mode' are both OFF. (Verified 10 Oct: all four checks false after this.)
challenge.challengeNote: Advent Together only gives stars (“We did it ✓”) on the real day, from 1 December. During an October test no star can be earned, so the tasks check that Grace set the app up correctly for her family and her church instead.

tasks.text: At home you will do Advent with your grandmother, Cucu Wanjiru, and your little brother, Baraka. Put them in, so their names appear on every day's reading.
tasks.hint: Look for the card called 'Our family'. Both names go in the same box.

tasks.text: Your pastor wants to print the paper with all 24 readings for the church. Make sure it shows your church's name: Mlima Hope Church.
tasks.hint: The church's name is not the family box. Look in the card 'For churches'.

tasks.text: You teach Sunday school, and you want to read the December readings NOW, in October, so you can prepare. Make the app open every door for you before its day.
tasks.hint: This is a choice for pastors and teachers. It is at the very bottom of the page, in this app's own Settings.

tasks.text: Cucu Wanjiru cannot read small words on a phone. Make the words in this app bigger for her.
tasks.hint: Use this app's own Settings at the bottom of the page (not the ? help button).

ownWords.question: In your own words, what is this app for?
keyIdeas: a short Bible reading, a prayer and one thing to do together each day before Christmas
for families and whole churches to walk through Advent together
you tap We did it each day to earn a star and keep a run of days

daily.task: Open today’s card in Advent Together and mark it done — or add a short note to any day.

explore.name: 🕯 Top · countdown · wreath
explore.try: Read the countdown. Look at the wreath and the four Sundays. Look at Share — don’t send.

explore.name: 📅 Today & the doors
explore.find: Tap Today, then scroll to the doors.
explore.try: Tap Today. Tap a locked door. Tap the Christmas door.

explore.name: 📖 Inside a door
explore.try: Read the verse. Tap Read it aloud, then stop it. Look at Share — don’t send. Close with ✕.

explore.name: 👪 Your family
explore.try: Type names (try a very long one and emoji). Look at your stars.

explore.name: ⛪ The church kit
explore.try: Type a church name. Tap Print (cancel). Copy the announcement.

explore.name: ⚙️ Settings
explore.try: Try bigger type and Preview mode, then put them back.
